en.bestFor: Showing one character put on the clothes from a reference image, piece by piece, then hold the finished look.
en.structure: Starts already wearing a white fitted tank and matching white tight shorts. One 3–4 second clip per new reference garment, plus one final clip where the full look holds.
en.hook: Opens in the white athletic base as the first distinct reference garment goes on. No title card.
en.arc: White tank and shorts, then each piece from the clothing reference. A reference bottom replaces the shorts. The last clip holds the complete look.
en.narrator: Silent by default. A short spoken line that names the finished look is added only when you ask for one, and only on the last clip.
en.visual: Look and palette come from the chosen visual style. One room and one locked full-body camera, with the character at a similar size. Face and hair stay on the blueprint. Clothes are copied from the reference images only.
en.audio: A music bed with one clothing sound effect per clip. Silent clips have no subtitle.
en.rules: Needs exactly one character and clothing reference images. Starts in a white fitted tank and white tight shorts, torso covered. Only the garments in those photos, one action per clip. Face and hair never change. No invented pieces.
